create_task.label: Create Task
create_task.description: Add a task to a Todoist project or your Inbox.

project_id.label: Project
project_id.description: Leave empty to add the task to your Inbox.

section_id.label: Section
section_id.description: Leave empty to add the task outside any section.

description.label: Description
description.description: Extra details shown under the title. Markdown is supported.

labels.label: Labels
labels.description: Names of personal or shared labels to add.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: 1 is normal, 4 is urgent; Todoist shows 4 as P1.

due_date.label: Due Date
due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or English words. Repeating dates work too.

update_task.label: Update Task
update_task.description: Change the title, details, labels, priority or due date of a task.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID, from a Create Task or Find Task step.

description.label: Description
description.description: Extra details shown under the title. Markdown is supported.

labels.label: Labels
labels.description: Replaces the task's labels with these names.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: 1 is normal, 4 is urgent; Todoist shows 4 as P1.

due_date.label: Due Date
due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or English words. Repeating dates work too.

find_task.label: Find Task
find_task.description: Find an open task by its exact title.

name.label: Title
name.description: Matches an open task whose title is exactly this text.

project_id.label: Project
project_id.description: Leave empty to search every project.

mark_task_completed.label: Mark Task as Completed
mark_task_completed.description: Complete a task. A recurring task moves to its next date.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID, from a Create Task or Find Task step.

todoist_filter_tasks.label: Filter Tasks
todoist_filter_tasks.description: Query active tasks using Todoist filter syntax.

query.label: Query
query.description: Todoist filter query. Examples: "today | overdue", "p1 & !#Work", "search: meeting", "no due date". Uses Todoist's native filter syntax.

lang.label: Language
lang.description: IETF language code for parsing date keywords in the query (e.g. "en", "de"). Defaults to the account language.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return per page (1-200, default 50). All matching pages are followed automatically.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the completed task to reopen (obtain from a completed-task list or Get Task).

todoist_move_task.label: Move Task
todoist_move_task.description: Move a task to a different project, section, or parent.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to move (obtain from Find Task or Filter Tasks).

project_id.label: Destination Project ID
project_id.description: Move the task into this project. 16-character base32 ID from List Projects. Provide at least one of project, section, or parent.

section_id.label: Destination Section ID
section_id.description: Move the task into this section. 16-character base32 ID from List Sections. Provide at least one of project, section, or parent.

parent_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_id.description: Make the task a sub-task of this parent task. 16-character base32 ID. Provide at least one of project, section, or parent.

todoist_move_task.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.project_id && !inputs.section_id && !inputs.parent_id) throw new Error('Move Task requires at least one destination: project_id, section_id, or parent_id.');
return request;

todoist_quick_add_task.label: Quick Add Task
todoist_quick_add_task.description: Create a task from a natural-language sentence.

text.label: Text
text.description: The task text with inline syntax. Use #Project to set the project, @label for labels, p1-p4 for priority, and natural-language dates. Example: "Submit report by Friday 5pm #Work p2".

note.label: Note
note.description: Optional note (comment) to attach to the created task.

auto_reminder.label: Auto Reminder
auto_reminder.description: Add a default reminder to the task if it has a due time.

todoist_get_task.label: Get Task
todoist_get_task.description: Fetch a single task by its ID.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to fetch (e.g. from a trigger payload, Find Task, or Filter Tasks).

todoist_list_completed_tasks.label: List Completed Tasks (by Completion Date)
todoist_list_completed_tasks.description: List tasks completed within a date window.

since.label: Since
since.description: Start of the window, RFC3339 datetime (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"). Tasks completed at or after this time are included.

until.label: Until
until.description: End of the window, RFC3339 datetime (e.g. "2026-06-27T23:59:59Z"). Must be within ~3 months of Since.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Optional. Limit results to this project (16-character base32 ID from List Projects).

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: Optional. Limit results to this section (16-character base32 ID from List Sections).

parent_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_id.description: Optional. Limit results to sub-tasks of this parent task.

filter_query.label: Filter Query
filter_query.description: Optional Todoist filter query to further narrow the results (same syntax as Filter Tasks).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum tasks per page (default 200). All pages are followed automatically.

todoist_list_completed_tasks_by_due_date.label: List Completed Tasks (by Due Date)
todoist_list_completed_tasks_by_due_date.description: List completed tasks whose due date falls in a window.

since.label: Since
since.description: Start of the due-date window, date "YYYY-MM-DD" or RFC3339 datetime (e.g. "2026-06-01").

until.label: Until
until.description: End of the due-date window, date "YYYY-MM-DD" or RFC3339 datetime (e.g. "2026-06-27"). Must be within the allowed window of Since.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Optional. Limit results to this project (16-character base32 ID from List Projects).

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: Optional. Limit results to this section (16-character base32 ID from List Sections).

parent_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_id.description: Optional. Limit results to sub-tasks of this parent task.

filter_query.label: Filter Query
filter_query.description: Optional Todoist filter query to further narrow the results (same syntax as Filter Tasks).

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum tasks per page (default 200). All pages are followed automatically.

color.label: Color
color.description: Color of the project icon. A Todoist color name, e.g. 'berry_red', 'blue', 'charcoal'.

parent_id.label: Parent Project ID
parent_id.description: ID of a parent project to nest this project under, making it a sub-project. Resolve the name to an ID via List Projects. Leave blank for a top-level project.

view_style.label: View Style
view_style.description: How the project is displayed in Todoist.

is_favorite.label: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

todoist_update_project.label: Update Project

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the project to update. Resolve via List Projects or Search Projects.

color.label: Color
color.description: New color of the project icon. A Todoist color name, e.g. 'berry_red', 'blue', 'charcoal'.

view_style.label: View Style
view_style.description: How the project is displayed in Todoist.

is_favorite.label: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Mark the project as a favorite, remove it from favorites, or leave the current setting unchanged.

todoist_get_project.label: Get Project
todoist_get_project.description: Get a single Todoist project by its ID.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the project to fetch. Resolve via List Projects or Search Projects.

todoist_list_projects.label: List Projects

todoist_search_projects.label: Search Projects

query.label: Query
query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against project names, e.g. 'work'. Leave blank to return all projects.

todoist_unarchive_project.label: Unarchive Project
todoist_unarchive_project.description: Restore an archived Todoist project to active.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the archived project to restore. Resolve via List Archived Projects.

todoist_list_archived_projects.label: List Archived Projects

todoist_create_section.label: Create Section
todoist_create_section.description: Create a new section within a Todoist project.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the project to add the section to. Resolve via List Projects or Search Projects.

order.label: Order
order.description: Order of the section among the other sections in the project (lower is higher).

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: ID of the section to rename. Resolve via List Sections or Search Sections.

todoist_get_section.label: Get Section
todoist_get_section.description: Get a single Todoist section by its ID.

section_id.label: Section ID
section_id.description: ID of the section to fetch. Resolve via List Sections or Search Sections.

todoist_list_sections.label: List Sections
todoist_list_sections.description: List Todoist sections, optionally filtered to one project.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Restrict to sections in this project. Resolve via List Projects. Leave blank to list sections across all projects.

todoist_search_sections.label: Search Sections

query.label: Query
query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against section names, e.g. 'todo'. Leave blank to return all sections in scope.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Restrict the search to sections in this project. Resolve via List Projects. Leave blank to search all projects.

todoist_list_archived_sections.label: List Archived Sections
todoist_list_archived_sections.description: List archived sections within a Todoist project.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: ID of the project whose archived sections to list. Resolve via List Projects or Search Projects.

todoist_create_label.label: Create Label
todoist_create_label.description: Creates a new personal label in Todoist.

name.label: Name
name.description: The label name. Between 1 and 128 characters.

color.label: Color
color.description: The label's color, as a Todoist color name (e.g. 'berry_red', 'blue', 'charcoal').

order.label: Order
order.description: Number used to sort the label in the list view (lower comes first).

is_favorite.label: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Whether the label is marked as a favorite.

todoist_update_label.label: Update Label
todoist_update_label.description: Updates an existing personal label in Todoist.

label_id.label: Label ID
label_id.description: The ID of the personal label to update. Obtain it via List Labels or Search Labels.

name.label: Name
name.description: New label name. Between 1 and 128 characters.

color.label: Color
color.description: The label's color, as a Todoist color name (e.g. 'berry_red', 'blue', 'charcoal').

order.label: Order
order.description: Number used to sort the label in the list view (lower comes first).

is_favorite.label: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Mark the label as a favorite, remove it from favorites, or leave the current setting unchanged.

todoist_get_label.label: Get Label
todoist_get_label.description: Gets a single personal label by ID in Todoist.

label_id.label: Label ID
label_id.description: The ID of the personal label to fetch. Obtain it via List Labels or Search Labels.

todoist_list_labels.label: List Labels
todoist_list_labels.description: Lists all of the user's personal labels in Todoist.

todoist_search_labels.label: Search Labels
todoist_search_labels.description: Searches personal labels by name in Todoist.

query.label: Query
query.description: Text to match against label names, case-insensitively (e.g. 'work').

todoist_list_shared_labels.label: List Shared Labels
todoist_list_shared_labels.description: Lists shared (workspace) label names in Todoist.

omit_personal.label: Omit Personal
omit_personal.description: When true, names that also exist as personal labels are excluded, returning only purely shared labels.

todoist_rename_shared_label.label: Rename Shared Label
todoist_rename_shared_label.description: Renames a shared (workspace) label across all tasks in Todoist.

name.label: Current Name
name.description: The existing shared label name to rename. Resolve it via List Shared Labels.

new_name.label: New Name
new_name.description: The new name to apply to the shared label.

todoist_rename_shared_label.afterResponse: return {success: true, name: inputs.name, new_name: inputs.new_name};

todoist_remove_shared_label.label: Remove Shared Label
todoist_remove_shared_label.description: Removes a shared (workspace) label from all tasks in Todoist.

name.label: Name
name.description: The shared label name to remove from all tasks. Resolve it via List Shared Labels.

todoist_create_task_comment.label: Create Task Comment
todoist_create_task_comment.description: Adds a comment to a Todoist task.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The ID of the task to comment on (e.g. "6X4Vv2hfXjqWf3wj"). Obtain it from Find Task or List Tasks.

content.label: Content
content.description: The comment text, 1 to 15000 characters. May contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks.

todoist_create_project_comment.label: Create Project Comment
todoist_create_project_comment.description: Adds a comment to a Todoist project.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: The ID of the project to comment on (e.g. "6X4Vv2hfXjqWf3wj"). Obtain it from List Projects.

content.label: Content
content.description: The comment text, 1 to 15000 characters. May contain markdown-formatted text and hyperlinks.

todoist_get_comment.label: Get Comment
todoist_get_comment.description: Fetches a single Todoist comment by its ID.

comment_id.label: Comment ID
comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve (e.g. "2992679862"). Obtain it from List Comments.

todoist_list_comments.label: List Comments
todoist_list_comments.description: Lists all comments on a Todoist task or project.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: The task whose comments to list (e.g. "6X4Vv2hfXjqWf3wj"). Provide this OR Project ID, not both.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: The project whose comments to list (e.g. "6X4Vv2hfXjqWf3wj"). Provide this OR Task ID, not both.

todoist_list_comments.beforeRequest:
if ((inputs.task_id && inputs.project_id) || (!inputs.task_id && !inputs.project_id)) throw new Error('Provide exactly one of Task ID or Project ID (they are mutually exclusive).');
return request;

todoist_get_current_user.label: Get Current User
todoist_get_current_user.description: Retrieves the authenticated Todoist user profile.

todoist_get_productivity_stats.label: Get Productivity Stats
todoist_get_productivity_stats.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's Todoist productivity statistics.

todoist_list_activity_log.label: List Activity Log

object_type.label: Object Type
object_type.description: Restrict to one object type. One of: "project", "item" (task), "note" (comment).

event_type.label: Event Type
event_type.description: Restrict to a single event type across all object types, e.g. "added", "updated", "completed", "deleted".

object_id.label: Object ID
object_id.description: Restrict to one specific object. Must be paired with Object Type (e.g. a task ID with object_type "item").

parent_project_id.label: Parent Project ID
parent_project_id.description: Restrict to one project and all of its tasks and comments. Resolve the ID via List Projects.

parent_item_id.label: Parent Task ID
parent_item_id.description: Restrict to one task and all of its comments. Resolve the ID via Find Task.

date_from.label: Date From
date_from.description: Only events on or after this instant, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z").

date_to.label: Date To
date_to.description: Only events before this instant (exclusive), ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z").

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of events to return per page.
